stock.description: Yeahka Limited operates a technology platform in China that delivers comprehensive payment and business services to both merchants and consumers. Its core offerings include end-to-end payment solutions, covering both app-based and traditional transaction methods. Beyond payments, the company provides an array of technology-driven business services, such as software-as-a-service (SaaS) products for merchants, precision marketing, and fintech services. Additionally, it facilitates in-store e-commerce, allowing for the display and sale of various merchant goods, including hotel and travel services, directly via its platform. Yeahka Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China.

provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.

provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
